imported_sources.boundary: Additive normalized-HS cohomology and initial eigenphase response only; fixed physical strength grows as tau*p. No multiplicative holonomy or microscopic limit.
Sufficient selected-sector deletion criterion only; the sector need not vanish for a valid full signed local law.
Abstract spectra, including deterministic existence via CUE local-average variance. Does not identify root labels or traces of the maintained propagator.
The implication is proved; H_diag and TRACE-005 for the frozen matrix remain open. Every fixed order and every compact bandwidth are required.
Conditional on the exact quantitative G1-G3 analytic inputs pinned in the source. Finite algebra checks do not recertify those analytic inputs. No cyclic Heisenberg trace bound.
Exact deterministic derivative and CUE reference covariance. Proxy computations are diagnostics, not a physical limit or a p-value.
Only the reduction is proved. The required physical parameter q-moment o(N^-2), or sixth moment O(N^-3), is unproved; Haar sixth moments cannot supply it.
Dense-mixing intensities with a fixed C and rho<1; cancellation is established only to an O(N^2) remainder. Equal-edge is smaller than the vertex-balanced sector.
m tends to infinity with m/sqrt(N) tending to a fixed finite c; not m of order N. Harer-Zagier is a classical external input.
Any unitary spectrum. The mixed-moment convergence premise for the frozen model is open; weak convergence alone supplies no unbounded count UI. Discrete Toeplitz contraction requires grid M>=N.
p is the characteristic polynomial of a unitary, with all roots on the unit circle. Self-inversiveness alone is insufficient. Required CUE excesses are positive and unproved for the physical family.
